messages:
erin: Quick sync — we're kicking off a minimal-priv rebase & signed-rootfs rotation for runtime images next week. Need RBAC + KMS + audit sign-off. @vikram @sarah @devsec
vikram: 👍 scope? runtime-only or build pipeline too?
sarah: runtime images + the attestation signing flow from the CI builder. Also want audit logs forwarded to the archive bucket, with schema v2 (image, tag, signer, key_id, action).
devsec: TL;DR security asks:
- Create new KMS key 'images-signer-v2' restricted to signer-sa only
- Remove broad iam.roles/container.admin from build service account and grant minimal sign/decrypt via IAM conditions
- Add an "audit-only" role that can read Cloud Audit Logs but not affect keys
kevin: Sounds right. How are we planning to roll keys without breaking canaries?
erin: Rollout plan (high level):
1) Create new key + signer-sa binding (no changes to prod yet).
2) Update canary pipeline to use new key + push signed image to canary registry (10% traffic).
3) Monitor audit logs & attestation verification for 48h.
4) If green, promote to full rollout. Fallback: keep old key valid for 7 days to allow retries.
vikram: Can you paste the RBAC snippet for the signer SA? I'll drop it into our infra PR.
sarah: here's the minimal IAM binding we discussed:
```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {
      "role": "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier",
      "members": ["serviceAccount:signer-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
    },
    {
      "role": "roles/logging.viewer",
      "members": ["serviceAccount:audit-reader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
    }
  ]
}
```
devsec: And the kubectl to restrict imagePull for the builder cluster (example):
```bash
kubectl create rolebinding builder-pull-restrict \
  --role=restricted-image-puller \
  --serviceaccount=ci:builder-sa -n prod
```
kevin: One more: we need an audit-forwarder job to enrich logs with key_id and image sha before archiving. Any volunteers for the lambda? :slightly_smiling_face:
erin: @vikram can you own the forwarder? I'll open infra tickets for key creation and the CI change.
vikram: I can take the forwarder. Plan to use a small Cloud Run job that subscribes to log sink, enriches and writes to GCS.
oncall-bot: reminder: image-rebuild-canary job scheduled 2026-03-29T03:00Z (initiated by erin) :robot_face:
sarah: Couple of risk notes:
- If we misconfigure KMS grants, CI will succeed but verification will fail at runtime. Add a CI check that verifies the signer signature against the public cert before promoting.
- Audit retention policy: make sure compliance has 365d for signed-image events.
devsec: Agreed. Also adding a small e2e that pulls the signed image and validates attestation in the runtime environment (not just in CI).
erin: Perfect. I'll draft the infra PR and set up the rollout schedule. Sync tomorrow 10am to review the IAM policy diffs. Thanks everyone.
kevin: Nice. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: deploybot: infra-pr/3821 opened by erin (diff: iam/bindings.json)
